sounds.whenToUse: A graphic or scene sliding in; gentle transitions between points.
Quick cuts, list items landing, fast pace moments.
Something being dismissed, deleted, or leaving the frame.
Build-up right before a reveal, result, or big claim.
Confirmation that something works; a key takeaway landing.
A small element appearing; a light touch on a minor point.
Describing a UI interaction: clicking, selecting, toggling.
Something failing, a wrong approach, a bug being shown.
A record-scratch 'wait, what?' pivot or sudden correction.
Dramatic emphasis on an absurd or shocking statement.
Everything stopping for an interjection or hard pivot.
